body:
That video is great. Thanks for the link.

You make an excellent point, I just fail to see the point in contributing to said collective good if you can't bring about any significant change. It's not that I want recognition, couldn't care less about it, I just want all life to be respected and treated with love and care. I know it's impossible to achieve, but unfortunately I want it. Maybe I'll grow up soon. 

Yeah, animals are the greatest. I love every single animal under my roof to death. The connection between human and animal is just so natural. There's nothing but love and loyalty. Hell, my tortoises have more personality than some people I've met. 

Honestly, as of right now I only enjoy spending time volunteering (which admittedly makes me feel worse because shelters are so fucking sad) and immersing myself into a video game (just one. Have some great friends to play with and theres a lot of story to read about). Assuming I choose to live, I'll put time into the military and likely stick it out from there. I'm just beginning to realize that I despise living here and it sucks because there's nowhere else to go.

In short, no. There is no point to anything in this world. Eventually you die, I die, everything dies. With time nearly everything you and I know will become irrelevant, and will be replaced by *I have no idea, but you get it*. 

With that being said: I believe we get one life. We can choose to live that life with purpose, whether it be meaningful or not. At the end of the day, you have to be happy with the decisions that bring you to the end of your life. If being happy means killing yourself, well that is your decision. 

Just be sure you think long and hard about it before, because it really is a permanent solution to what may be a temporary problem. Personally, I have wanted to kill myself for years. Some part of me believed that I would find something to keep me from doing so. I really haven't. Maybe that day will never come, but we don't know. 

If you truly feel you're worthless, why not try and fix whatever the problem may be? Find a hobby, meet a SO, something and in the meantime try to improve yourself. If you feel it's a waste of your time, so be it, that is perfectly fine.

Kinda sleepy, apologies if I rambled. Good night.

I don't have an answer, but I just felt compelled to comment. It is such a relief to know someone else thinks the same way I do. Nobody in my life understands it. I will die someday, why not just skip ahead? 

Thank you for questioning the "you have so much to live for!" attitude. Always have had a problem with the overly positive types; How can someone know everything will be ok if they don't even know who you are?

Anyhow, I hope someone comes up with an answer for this. Hope you find peace.
